## What changed

Describe the user-facing or API-level change.

## Why

Explain the problem, design decision, and alternatives considered.

## Verification

- [ ] `vp check`
- [ ] `vp test run`
- [ ] `vp pack`
- [ ] `npm run verify:package`
- [ ] `npm run verify:showcase`
- [ ] `vp build`
- [ ] `npm run verify:site-css`

## Component quality

- [ ] Public props and exports are typed and documented.
- [ ] Keyboard, screen-reader, touch, reduced-motion, and responsive behavior
      were considered.
- [ ] Streaming updates avoid unnecessary rerenders.
- [ ] API changes include tests and a changelog entry.

## Screenshots or recordings

Include before/after evidence for visual or interaction changes.
